name: border-beam

frames.best_why: Frame 5 shows a bright beam segment on the edge of all three cards at once.

tagline: A thin coloured light keeps circling the edge of each card.
summary: A glowing gradient segment travels around the rounded border of whatever container it is dropped into. Colour, width, speed and start delay are configurable.
appearance: Three dark rounded cards sit on a black stage. Along their thin grey borders a short bright segment glows, amber-to-purple on one card and cyan-to-pink on another, each with a small text label and hex caption.
behaviour: A small gradient light runs continuously around each border, looping every few seconds without stopping. The cards themselves stay still.
demo_content: Labels Default beam, Custom beam and Delayed, with colour hex captions.
use_when: A card needs to look active or loading without adding a spinner or changing its layout.
avoid_when: The beam is faint on light cards and needs a relative, rounded parent to clip it properly.
customise: Size, duration, borderWidth, anchor, colorFrom, colorTo and delay are props; the parent must be relative and rounded for the mask to fit.
weight_why: One pseudo-element running a CSS keyframe on offset-distance; no script.

a11y.note: Decorative light with no reduced-motion check, and it relies on modern offset-path support.

issues: The beam is thin and faint, so the motion is easy to miss at a glance.
polish_why: Tasteful and smooth, but the thin beam is easy to miss against the dark cards.
